summary: Fixed Set._complement for finite sets by distinguishing definitely excluded elements from undecidable membership and preserving the latter in an unevaluated Complement. Added regression coverage for the reported mixed symbols/numbers case, known outside elements, substitution, symbolic expressions/endpoints, and numerical controls. Confirmed the regression fails before the fix. Ran public Python bin/test sympy/sets/tests --no-colors --no-subprocess: 117 passed, 3 expected failures, exit 0. Inspected final diff.
